rules.text: Returns are accepted for a refund within 30-days of receipt.
rules.quote: Returns are accepted for a refund within 30-days of receipt.

rules.text: All returned merchandise will incur a return shipping fee of $9.99 per return deducted from the refund.
rules.quote: All returned merchandise will incur a return shipping fee of $9.99 per return.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds 'deducted from the refund,' which is not explicitly stated in the quote.

rules.text: Furniture, mattresses, wall art, mirrors, lamps, and artificial trees may incur a 15% restocking fee of the purchase price in addition to the $9.99 return shipping fee.
rules.quote: Furniture, mattresses, wall art, mirrors, lamps, and artificial trees may incur a 15% restocking fee of the purchase price in addition to the $9.99 return shipping fee.

rules.text: Furniture is non-returnable unless damaged upon delivery and refused at delivery; otherwise customer pays return shipping.
rules.quote: Furniture. If the item arrived damaged upon delivery, do not accept the delivery. If you accept the delivery, you shall be responsible for return shipping costs.

rules.text: Items already assembled, altered apparel, special orders, cloth face masks, perishable or personalized/monogrammed items, and final sale items cannot be returned.
rules.quote:
Items that have already been assembled by you.

*   Altered apparel, special orders, cloth face mask coverings, perishable or personalized/monogrammed items, and items identified as "final sale" cannot be returned.

rules.text: Intimates such as lingerie, swimsuits and undergarments are non-returnable.
rules.quote: Intimates such as lingerie, swimsuits and undergarments, etc.
rules.reviewNote: The quote does not explicitly state that these items are 'non-returnable,' only listing them as 'intimates such as lingerie, swimsuits and undergarments, etc.' without the explicit non-returnable condition.

rules.text: Beauty products may be returned within 30 days if unopened, unused, and original cellophane intact.
rules.quote: Beauty products may be returned if they are unopened, unused, and the original cellophane is fully intact.

rules.text: Return shipping fee and/or restocking fee will be waived if item was damaged in shipping, incorrect, or defective.
rules.quote:
For the following conditions the return shipping fee and/or restocking fee will be waived:

*   The item was damaged in the initial shipping process.
    
*   An incorrect item was shipped by us; or
    
*   We shipped a defective item.

rules.text: Refunds will be credited to the original form of payment for the net price after discounts and/or coupons.
rules.quote: Refunds will be credited to the original form of payment for the net price after discounts and/or coupons- no exceptions.
